svg.title: Подъём гантелей Y лёжа на скамье — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. PRONE INCLINE BENCH Y-RAISE with TWO light DUMBBELLS. View from elevated rear three-quarter so bench and Y shape visible. Both figures lie FACE DOWN with CHEST AND BELLY supported by an incline weight bench (about 30 degrees), head beyond upper end, feet on floor behind bench. Left: both arms hang straight down towards floor, dumbbell in each hand. Right: raise both almost-straight arms forward-and-out above head into a wide Y, thumbs up. Chest stays on bench. NOT standing, not overhead press, not prone T raise. Show entire bench and supporting legs. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
